alt: A smiling woman sits on a white bench in a wildflower meadow with a toddler girl on her lap and a boy in a green cap at her side
A boy in a green cap and navy T-shirt walks away down a dirt path between rows of poppies and wildflowers
A boy in a green cap kneels in an old wooden farm wagon beside a grinning toddler girl in red bows, a field and tree line behind them
A boy grins through the legs of a pink play stool, gripping its wooden legs above a metal bucket
A toddler girl in a rainbow-striped shirt grins over a cup of ice cream with sprinkles at a picnic table
A boy sticks out his tongue on a crowded stage of day campers in matching navy T-shirts and white kippot
A toddler girl in a pink Minnie Mouse top rests her chin on a playground bar, apartment buildings and trees behind her
A boy in a black cap and tie-dye shirt frames a shot with a blue toy camera on a long walkway bridge, a flag in the hazy distance
A boy makes a wide-eyed face behind a board of grilled sausages and vegetable skewers at a picnic table in the woods
A boy in a blue T-shirt with binoculars around his neck crosses his arms in front of a tall waterfall in the woods
